Game Overview

Skeleton King puts players into a snake experience centered on guide a spooky skeleton snake through a vibrant maze, devouring chickens to grow stronger. With every tasty bite, the challenge intensifies. Dodge your own bones and aim for the crown in this endlessly fun and addictive adventure. Are you cunning enough to become the Skeleton King?

How to Play

Playing Skeleton King comes down to a simple loop. Guide a spooky skeleton snake through a vibrant maze, devouring chickens to grow stronger. With every tasty bite, the challenge intensifies. Dodge your own bones and aim for the crown in this endlessly fun and addictive adventure. Are you cunning enough to become the Skeleton King?
